items.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO Amid Scandal
points: Jensen Huang, Nvidia's co-founder and 33-year CEO, resigned following reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset and a senior Nvidia executive.
CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement.
Nvidia stock plunged 14%, hitting a 52-week low of $148.80 before paring losses, while rivals AMD and Broadcom rose nearly 6%; Nvidia-backed cloud firm CoreWeave also declined.
Market pricing implies only 5% odds the stock reaches $216 this month (a 31% rally) from the current ~$165 level.

Industry reaction was split: Binance founder CZ called it 'a massive mistake' and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney called it 'a sad day for Nvidia, developers, America, and all humanity,' while Elon Musk said hiring Huang elsewhere 'would be an honor.'
Open-source AI developers worry Nvidia may reduce its support for open models under new leadership.
Nvidia reports Q3 earnings Tuesday, the first major market test of Kress's leadership and strategic direction post-Huang.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Outflows and Tether Gold Audit
points: Spot Bitcoin ETFs (exchange-traded funds that hold Bitcoin and trade on stock exchanges) saw $1.4 billion in outflows over five days as investors reduced risk exposure.
Analysts note the outflows don't necessarily signal a collapse in long-term demand.
Tether Gold (XAUT), a stablecoin backed by physical gold, received a clean audit from KPMG (one of the 'Big Four' global accounting firms) confirming $2.2 billion in physical gold backing.

items.title: MSCI Removes Strategy From Its Indexes
points: MSCI (a major index provider used by institutional investors to benchmark portfolios) removed Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) from its global indexes, reducing its visibility to institutional funds.

items.title: Cardone Capital Buys Bitcoin Dip
points: Cardone Capital purchased 20 Bitcoin worth $1.4 million during recent market weakness, signaling continued institutional accumulation at lower prices.

issues.subject: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia 👋

headlines: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO after 33 years following reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and company executive; CFO Colette Kress becomes interim chief while board searches for permanent replacement.
Nvidia stock plunged 14% on the news while competitors AMD and Broadcom climbed nearly 6%, and Nvidia-backed CoreWeave slid as investors reassess the chipmaker's leadership.

Tech and crypto leaders divided on the decision: Binance founder CZ called it 'a massive mistake,' while Elon Musk said hiring Huang elsewhere 'would be an honor'; some fear reduced support for open-source AI.
Nvidia will report third-quarter earnings Tuesday in first market test of post-Huang leadership; prediction markets give only 5% odds the stock hits $216 this month from current ~$165 level.

sections.title: Leadership Transition and Market Impact
points: Jensen Huang, co-founder and 33-year CEO, resigned following personal conduct reports involving an alleged Chinese intelligence asset and a senior Nvidia executive.
CFO Colette Kress takes interim role; board has launched formal search for permanent replacement.
Nvidia shares hit 52-week low of $148.80 Thursday before paring losses; rivals benefited with AMD and Broadcom up ~6% and CoreWeave (Nvidia-backed cloud company) declining.
Market expectations: stock would need 31% rally to reach $216; prediction odds at just 5% for November.

sections.title: Industry and Leadership Reactions
points: Binance founder CZ publicly opposed the decision, calling it 'a massive mistake' and questioning the board's judgment.
Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney called it 'a sad day for NVIDIA, developers, America, and all humanity.'
Open-source AI developers expressed concern Nvidia may now be less committed to championing open models under new leadership.
Elon Musk signaled interest in Huang, stating hiring him 'would be an honor,' suggesting potential talent competition.

sections.title: Market Outlook
points: Third-quarter earnings report Tuesday represents major catalyst; investors will scrutinize Kress's performance and strategic direction.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs bled $1.4 billion in five days as investors reduced risk exposure; however analysts note outflows don't yet signal collapse in demand.
Tether Gold (XAUT) received full KPMG Big Four audit confirming $2.2 billion in physical gold backing, strengthening trust in crypto stablecoins.
